svg.title: K24 · The nightly reset that never started: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 24: Clock (schedule: every minute); CronJob nightly-reset (suspend: true, never fires); Jobs (none yet). Your mission: It runs every minute. Why has nothing run?
